_doc: NPCs standing at the hub's stores (J00BA, 2026-11-14). spot = a name in hub_town.json npc_spots; offset = metres in the spot's own frame (x right, z back); turn = extra yaw in degrees (the Imp NPCs face +z in Blockbench, the others -z; the crafter spots face their station, so the crafters turn round to face the street and stand aside); scale: the Imp NPCs are Imp-body files (about 101 units = 1.15 m), the others are 18 units = the Imp's height. Placed by scripts/world/hub_town.gd.
